## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Sintra, Portugal. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at Ticket Office Pena Park, Estrada da Pena 9, 2710-609 Sintra, Portugal. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance to Pena Park. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio tour invites you to explore Pena Park at your own pace, discovering its enchanting forests, royal history, and hidden architectural treasures.
>
> Note that the park is hilly, so wear comfortable shoes! A shuttle bus is available for an additional fee to take you from the main entrance toward Pena Palace. However, we recommend walking to fully immerse yourself in the magical atmosphere.
>
> Discover how King Ferdinand II transformed a hilltop monastery into a 19th-century Romantic masterpiece. Explore carefully designed landscapes and uncover stories of earthquakes, queens, and artistic vision that shaped Portugal's heritage.
>
> Your journey begins at the Main Entrance of Pena Park, near the Palácio da Pena bus stop, served by bus 434 from Sintra railway station. Visit the colorful Pena Palace and discover hidden gems such as the Temple of Columns, the Warrior Statue, and the breathtaking High Cross.
>
> The route continues through peaceful gardens to the picturesque Valley of the Lakes. Here, you can exit through the Lakes Entrance and catch bus 434 at the Vale dos Lagos stop back toward Sintra. Alternatively, walk another 20–30 minutes to the charming Chalet of the Countess of Edla, surrounded by beautiful gardens. Afterward, you can leave through the Chalet Entrance, where there is no nearby bus stop, or return to the Lakes Entrance to catch the bus.
